```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# ATAC-seq Plotting: Layered Drawing + Full Gene Track Reference
# ==============================================================================

# 1. Load Libraries
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(Gviz)
    library(rtracklayer)
    library(GenomicFeatures)
    library(org.Hs.eg.db)
    library(grid)
})

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CONFIGURATION
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
mane_gff_path <- "../data/MANE/MANE.GRCh38.v1.5.refseq_genomic.gff.gz"
bw_dir <- "../data/A172_GBM_ATAC_seq/"
bw_files <- c(
    "48hr_0.mRp.clN.bigWig", "48hr_10.mRp.clN.bigWig", "48hr_50.mRp.clN.bigWig", "48hr_100.mRp.clN.bigWig",
    "96hr_0.mRp.clN.bigWig", "96hr_10.mRp.clN.bigWig", "96hr_50.mRp.clN.bigWig", "96hr_100.mRp.clN.bigWig"
)
track_color <- "#8C8C8C" # Grey (use "#8C8C8C" for grey, or "#377eb8" for blue)
output_dir <- "./outputs/all_bigwigs_dense_and_full_gene_tracks_MMR/"

# Ensure output directory exists
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Genes to Highlight (Red)
HIGHLIGHT_GENES <- c("MSH2", "MSH6", "MLH1", "PMS2")

# Load TxDb
if (!file.exists(mane_gff_path)) stop("MANE GFF file not found!")
message("Loading TxDb...")
txdb_mane <- makeTxDbFromGFF(mane_gff_path, format = "gff")
seqlevelsStyle(txdb_mane) <- "UCSC"
gen <- "hg38"

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# HELPER 1: Robust Gene Key Lookup
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
get_real_db_key <- function(symbol, txdb) {
    all_keys <- keys(txdb, keytype = "GENEID")
    if (symbol %in% all_keys) {
        return(symbol)
    }

    entrez_id <- suppressMessages(mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,
        keys = symbol, column = "ENTREZID",
        keytype = "SYMBOL", multiVals = "first"
    ))
    if (!is.na(entrez_id)) {
        if (entrez_id %in% all_keys) {
            return(entrez_id)
        }
        if (paste0("GeneID:", entrez_id) %in% all_keys) {
            return(paste0("GeneID:", entrez_id))
        }
    }
    return(NULL)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# HELPER 2: Pure Math Gene Model (Splits CDS and UTR)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
get_window_gene_model <- function(region_gr, txdb) {
    # 1. Find transcripts
    txs_in_window <- subsetByOverlaps(transcripts(txdb), region_gr)
    if (length(txs_in_window) == 0) {
        return(NULL)
    }

    tx_ids <- txs_in_window$tx_id
    tx_names <- txs_in_window$tx_name

    gene_ids <- tryCatch(
        {
            unlist(mapIds(txdb, keys = as.character(tx_ids), column = "GENEID", keytype = "TXID", multiVals = "first"))
        },
        error = function(e) {
            return(rep(NA, length(tx_ids)))
        }
    )

    # 2. Extract Components (Calculated)
    cds_list <- cdsBy(txdb, by = "tx")
    ex_list <- exonsBy(txdb, by = "tx")

    final_gr <- GRanges()

    # 3. Build Model Loop
    for (i in seq_along(tx_ids)) {
        tid_str <- as.character(tx_ids[i])
        gid <- if (is.na(gene_ids[i])) "Unknown" else gene_ids[i]
        parts <- GRanges()

        if (tid_str %in% names(ex_list)) {
            exs <- ex_list[[tid_str]]

            if (tid_str %in% names(cds_list)) {
                cds <- cds_list[[tid_str]]
                cds$feature <- "CDS"

                # Math: UTR = Exon - CDS
                utrs <- GenomicRanges::setdiff(exs, cds)
                if (length(utrs) > 0) utrs$feature <- "UTR"

                parts <- c(cds, utrs)
            } else {
                exs$feature <- "UTR"
                parts <- exs
            }
        }

        if (length(parts) > 0) {
            parts$transcript <- tx_names[i]
            parts$gene <- gid
            parts$exon <- paste0("exon_", seq_along(parts))
            final_gr <- c(final_gr, parts)
        }
    }

    # 4. Symbol Mapping
    unique_gids <- unique(final_gr$gene)
    unique_gids <- unique_gids[!is.na(unique_gids) & unique_gids != "Unknown"]

    if (length(unique_gids) > 0) {
        clean_gids <- gsub("^GeneID:", "", unique_gids)
        sym_map <- tryCatch(
            {
                mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,
                    keys = clean_gids, column = "SYMBOL",
                    keytype = "ENTREZID", multiVals = "first"
                )
            },
            error = function(e) {
                return(NULL)
            }
        )

        final_syms <- if (is.null(sym_map)) clean_gids else sym_map
        names(final_syms) <- unique_gids
        if (!is.null(sym_map)) {
            names(sym_map) <- unique_gids
            safe_syms <- sym_map
        } else {
            safe_syms <- final_syms
        }
        safe_syms[is.na(safe_syms)] <- clean_gids[is.na(safe_syms)]
        final_gr$symbol <- safe_syms[final_gr$gene]
    } else {
        final_gr$symbol <- final_gr$gene
    }

    final_gr$feature <- ifelse(final_gr$feature == "CDS", "CDS", "UTR")
    return(final_gr)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PLOTTING FUNCTION
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
generate_plot <- function(target_gene) {
    message(paste("Generating plot for:", target_gene))

    loc <- get_gene_center(target_gene, txdb_mane)
    if (is.null(loc)) {
        warning(paste("Skipping", target_gene, "- not found"))
        return()
    }

    start_pos <- floor(loc$midpoint - 250000)
    end_pos <- floor(loc$midpoint + 249999)
    chrom <- loc$chrom
    region_gr <- GRanges(chrom, IRanges(start_pos, end_pos))

    message(paste("  Region:", chrom, start_pos, "-", end_pos))

    # 1. Build Full Model
    full_model <- get_window_gene_model(region_gr, txdb_mane)
    if (is.null(full_model)) {
        warning("No gene model found.")
        return()
    }

    # 2. SEPARATE INTO 3 GROUPS
    is_target <- full_model$symbol %in% HIGHLIGHT_GENES
    is_target[is.na(is_target)] <- FALSE

    # Group A: Grey Neighbors (Everything not in highlight list)
    gr_grey <- full_model[!is_target]

    # Group B: Target UTRs Only
    gr_red_utr <- full_model[is_target & full_model$feature == "UTR"]

    # Group C: Target CDS Only
    gr_red_cds <- full_model[is_target & full_model$feature == "CDS"]

    # 3. Create Tracks
    common_args <- list(
        genome = gen, chromosome = chrom, start = start_pos, end = end_pos,
        name = "Genes", stacking = "dense", collapseTranscripts = FALSE,
        transcriptAnnotation = "symbol",
        fontcolor.group = "black", fontsize.group = 7, fontface.group = 2,
        just.group = "below", background.title = "transparent",
        col.title = "black", margin = 0, innerMargin = 0,
        col = "transparent"
    )

    track_list <- list()

    # Track 1: Grey Neighbors
    if (length(gr_grey) > 0) {
        # Treat everything as "UTR" logic (thin/thick handled automatically by Gviz defaults)
        # OR force everything grey
        track_list[[1]] <- do.call(GeneRegionTrack, c(list(range = gr_grey, fill = "grey80", thinBoxFill = "grey80", thinBoxFeature = "UTR"), common_args))
    }

    # Track 2: Red UTRs (FORCE THIN)
    if (length(gr_red_utr) > 0) {
        # We pass only UTRs and tell Gviz "Everything here is a UTR"
        # This guarantees they are drawn as thin lines
        track_list[[length(track_list) + 1]] <- do.call(GeneRegionTrack, c(list(range = gr_red_utr, fill = "red", thinBoxFill = "red", thinBoxFeature = "UTR"), common_args))
    }

    # Track 3: Red CDS (FORCE THICK)
    if (length(gr_red_cds) > 0) {
        # We pass only CDS and tell Gviz "Nothing here is a UTR" (thinBoxFeature="NONE")
        # This guarantees they are drawn as thick boxes
        track_list[[length(track_list) + 1]] <- do.call(GeneRegionTrack, c(list(range = gr_red_cds, fill = "red", thinBoxFill = "red", thinBoxFeature = "NONE"), common_args))
    }

    # 4. Overlay Tracks (Dense Gene Track)
    combined_genes <- OverlayTrack(trackList = track_list, showTitle = FALSE, background.title = "transparent")

    # 5. NEW: Full Gene Track Reference (For Illustrator)
    ref_track <- GeneRegionTrack(txdb_mane,
        genome = gen, chromosome = chrom, start = start_pos, end = end_pos,
        name = "Ref", transcriptAnnotation = "symbol",
        just.group = "below", stacking = "squish",
        collapseTranscripts = FALSE,
        showTitle = FALSE, background.title = "transparent",
        fontsize.group = 7, fontcolor.group = "black",
        col.line = "black", fill = "grey90", col = "transparent"
    )

    # FIX: Map symbols for Ref track manually
    # Gviz TxDb tracks use Entrez IDs/Gene IDs by default. We need to map them to Symbols.
    if (length(ranges(ref_track)) > 0) {
        # 1. Get Transcript Names (e.g. NM_000179.3)
        tx_names <- transcript(ref_track)

        # 2. Map Transcript -> Entrez Gene ID using the TxDb itself
        # This is robust because it uses the internal linkage of the TxDb object
        gids <- tryCatch(
            {
                suppressMessages(mapIds(txdb_mane, keys = tx_names, column = "GENEID", keytype = "TXNAME", multiVals = "first"))
            },
            error = function(e) {
                # Fallback if TXNAME keytype fails (unlikely for TxDb)
                return(rep(NA, length(tx_names)))
            }
        )

        # 3. Map Entrez Gene ID -> Symbol using OrgDb
        clean_gids <- gsub("^GeneID:", "", gids)

        # Only map valid, non-NA, non-Unknown IDs
        to_map <- unique(clean_gids[!is.na(clean_gids) & clean_gids != "Unknown" & clean_gids != ""])

        valid_syms <- character(0)
        if (length(to_map) > 0) {
            valid_syms <- tryCatch(
                {
                    suppressMessages(mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = to_map, column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ENTREZID", multiVals = "first"))
                },
                error = function(e) {
                    return(NULL)
                }
            )
        }

        # 4. Construct final Symbol vector
        # Start with original Transcript Name or Gene ID as fallback
        syms <- tx_names

        # Use Gene ID if available (better than TxName if symbol fails)
        has_gid <- !is.na(clean_gids) & clean_gids != "Unknown"
        syms[has_gid] <- clean_gids[has_gid]

        # Overwrite with Symbol if successfully mapped
        if (!is.null(valid_syms)) {
            # valid_syms names correspond to to_map (Gene IDs)
            # Find indices in clean_gids that match to_map
            matches <- match(clean_gids, names(valid_syms))

            # Identify which clean_gids have a valid match
            has_match <- !is.na(matches)

            # Apply map
            syms[has_match] <- valid_syms[matches[has_match]]
        }

        # Use "Unknown" for any remaining NAs
        syms[is.na(syms)] <- "Unknown"

        # 4. Fallback: if symbol is NA, keep gene ID or transcript ID
        syms[is.na(syms)] <- clean_gids[is.na(syms)]
        syms[is.na(syms) | syms == "Unknown"] <- tx_names[is.na(syms) | syms == "Unknown"]

        # Assign back to "symbol" for transcriptAnnotation="symbol" to work
        ranges(ref_track)$symbol <- syms
    }

    # 6. BigWig Data Tracks
    max_scores <- sapply(bw_files, function(f) {
        f_path <- file.path(bw_dir, paste0("GSM9825200_", f))
        if (file.exists(f_path)) {
            imported_bw <- import.bw(f_path, selection = region_gr)
            if (length(imported_bw) > 0) {
                return(max(score(imported_bw)))
            }
        }
        return(0)
    })
    global_ymax <- max(max_scores) * 1.05
    tick_interval <- if (global_ymax <= 3) 1 else 2

    bw_tracks <- lapply(bw_files, function(f) {
        f_path <- file.path(bw_dir, paste0("GSM9825200_", f))
        track_name <- gsub(".mRp.clN.bigWig", "", f)
        track_name <- gsub("_", " ", track_name)

        DataTrack(
            range = f_path, genome = gen, type = "histogram",
            chromosome = chrom, name = track_name, ylim = c(0, global_ymax),
            yTicksAt = seq(0, floor(global_ymax), by = tick_interval),
            col.histogram = track_color, fill.histogram = track_color,
            # Remove Blue Block but Keep Axis
            background.title = "transparent",
            col.title = "black", fontcolor.title = "black", fontsize.title = 6, cex.title = 1.0, fontface.title = 1,
            col.axis = "black", fontcolor.axis = "black", fontsize.axis = 6, cex.axis = 1.0, fontface.axis = 1,
            margin = 2, innerMargin = 2, # Small margin to prevent clipping
            showTitle = TRUE
        )
    })

    # Scale Bar (Thinner line, smaller font)
    # Using labelPos="above" as requested by user
    strack <- GenomeAxisTrack(scale = 0.2, labelPos = "above", showTitle = FALSE, col = "#666666", fontcolor = "#666666", fontsize = 6, lwd = 1)

    # Spacer Track to create vertical gap between bigwig tracks
    spacer_track <- AnnotationTrack(
        range = GenomicRanges::GRanges(), genome = gen, chromosome = chrom,
        name = "", background.title = "transparent", col.title = "transparent",
        background.panel = "transparent", col.frame = "transparent"
    )

    # Interleave bigwig tracks with spacer tracks
    bw_tracks_with_spacers <- list()
    h_data_with_spacers <- numeric()
    for (i in seq_along(bw_tracks)) {
        bw_tracks_with_spacers <- c(bw_tracks_with_spacers, list(bw_tracks[[i]]))
        h_data_with_spacers <- c(h_data_with_spacers, 0.5)
        if (i < length(bw_tracks)) {
            bw_tracks_with_spacers <- c(bw_tracks_with_spacers, list(spacer_track))
            h_data_with_spacers <- c(h_data_with_spacers, 0.05) # Spacer height
        }
    }

    # Layout (Fixed)
    h_gene <- 0.3
    h_ref <- 1.1
    h_scale <- 0.4 # More vertical space for label

    track_list <- c(list(strack), bw_tracks_with_spacers, list(combined_genes, ref_track))
    track_sizes <- c(h_scale, h_data_with_spacers, h_gene, h_ref)

    # 1. Save PDF
    fname_pdf <- paste0(output_dir, "Plot_", target_gene, ".pdf")
    pdf(fname_pdf, width = 4, height = sum(track_sizes))

    plotTracks(track_list,
        from = start_pos, to = end_pos, chromosome = chrom,
        # Add gene title (ensure it is black and visible)
        main = target_gene, cex.main = 0.5, margin = 40, col.main = "black", col.title = "black",
        sizes = track_sizes, title.width = 0.6
    )
    dev.off()
    message(paste("Saved PDF:", fname_pdf))

    # 2. Save PNG
    fname_png <- paste0(output_dir, "Plot_", target_gene, ".png")
    png(fname_png, width = 4, height = sum(track_sizes), units = "in", res = 300)

    plotTracks(track_list,
        from = start_pos, to = end_pos, chromosome = chrom,
        # Add gene title (ensure it is black and visible)
        main = target_gene, cex.main = 0.5, margin = 40, col.main = "black", col.title = "black",
        sizes = track_sizes, title.width = 0.6
    )
    dev.off()
    message(paste("Saved PNG:", fname_png))
}

# Helper for Center
get_gene_center <- function(symbol, txdb) {
    db_key <- get_real_db_key(symbol, txdb)
    if (is.null(db_key)) {
        return(NULL)
    }
    g_range <- genes(txdb)[db_key]
    list(chrom = as.character(seqnames(g_range))[1], midpoint = (start(g_range) + end(g_range)) / 2)
}

# Run
genes_to_plot <- c("MSH2", "MSH6", "MLH1", "PMS2")
for (g in genes_to_plot) generate_plot(g)
```
